instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot, slightly high angle. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right with his back partially to the camera. He reaches his right hand to touch the waist of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the right facing him. In the background, motion capture equipment and a printer are visible. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
